privacyNotice: Your data is stored only on this device.

what.title: What data we use
what.body: Your profile (age, sex for calculation purposes, weight, height, goal and activity), what you eat, water, activity, weigh-ins and shopping preferences. Weight and height are health data under the GDPR (Art. 9), so we handle them with special care.

where.title: Where it is stored
where.body: Only on this device, in the browser's storage (IndexedDB). There are no accounts and no server holding your data. If you clear your browser data or uninstall the app, it is lost.

network.title: What leaves your device
network.body: Only what you search for (text or barcode) when you tap "Search Open Food Facts and USDA". The Open Food Facts search goes directly from your device to their servers (as when visiting their website, they see your IP address). The USDA search goes through our intermediate server, which forwards it and temporarily caches the result (not who searched). Your profile and meals are never sent. The hosting provider may log technical data, such as IP address, under its own policy.

analytics.title: Cookies and analytics
analytics.body: We don't use cookies or analytics. If privacy-friendly analytics is ever added, it will be optional and we'll ask for your permission first.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can download all your data (Settings → Export my data) and delete it completely (Settings → Delete all my data) at any time.

age.title: Minimum age
age.body: The app is for people aged 18 or over.

medical.title: Not medical advice
medical.body: Targets and alerts are estimates. If you have a health condition, are pregnant or have had difficulties with food, please talk to a healthcare professional.
